speech.jaymoskingdoms.siege.ask.0: %1$s is at our walls. You're about the seat of %2$s, stranger: which side are you on?
speech.jaymoskingdoms.siege.ask.1: They've come from %1$s to take %2$s. Will you hold the walls with us, or not?
speech.jaymoskingdoms.siege.reply.defend: Good. Get to the walls. Our lord will open the war chest to you.
Then go to our lord: the war chest is open to you.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.siege.reply.out.0: Keep out of the way, then.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.siege.reply.out.1: Stay clear of the gate and nobody will trouble you.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.warchest.open: The war chest holds %s. What shall we spend it on?
speech.jaymoskingdoms.warchest.mend: Send masons to mend the walls (%s)
speech.jaymoskingdoms.warchest.gate: An iron gate across the door (%s)
speech.jaymoskingdoms.warchest.draught: A fighting draught for the defenders (%s)
speech.jaymoskingdoms.defences.gatehouse: Never again. We'll have a gatehouse built, whatever it costs.
A proper gatehouse. Tell the builders.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.defences.tower.0: We'll raise a tower, so we see them coming next time.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.defences.tower.1: A tower on the walls. Pay the builders from the treasury.
We need more men under arms. Build barracks.
Barracks, and soon. We were too few.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.whiteflag.stand.1: Lower your weapons. Let's hear them out.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.whiteflag.refuse.0: A white rag won't save you.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.whiteflag.broken.0: They broke the white! Kill them!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.whiteflag.terms.ow: You've a debt to %s. How will you settle it?
speech.jaymoskingdoms.whiteflag.terms.cl: %s has nothing against you. Say what you want, then go.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.whiteflag.paid.0: Paid, then. Off with you, and mind the law.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.whiteflag.let_go.0: There's no charge on you. Go on.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.whiteflag.let_go.1: Nothing to answer for. Away with you.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.colours.look.1: Hold on. I don't know your face.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.colours.seen.0: That's not one of ours! A spy in the colours of %s!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.colours.seen.1: You're no soldier of %s. Seize them!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.fixer.open.0: Somebody wants your head. I know whose palms to grease.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.fixer.open.1: Bad name, have you? I can fix that. For a price.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.fixer.none.0: Your name's clean as anyone's. Nothing for me to do.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.fixer.none.1: Nobody's after you that I can't wait a day on.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.fixer.done.0: Done. Nobody in %s remembers a thing.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.fixer.done.1: A word in the right ear. %s will think better of you now.
